name: Oath of Vengeance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A relentless avenger sworn to punish grievous wrongs, marking a foe and hunting it down.

feature.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
feature.summary: Bane and Hunter's Mark always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: When you reach a Paladin level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Bane and Hunter's Mark (3); Hold Person and Misty Step (5); Haste and Protection from Energy (9); Banishment and Dimension Door (13); Hold Monster and Scrying (17).

feature.name: Vow of Enmity
feature.summary: When you take the Attack action, spend Channel Divinity: Advantage on attacks against one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute.
feature.text: When you take the Attack action, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to swear a vow against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You have Advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can move the vow to a different creature within 30 feet (no action required).

feature.name: Relentless Avenger
feature.summary: When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, the target's Speed drops to 0 and you can move half your Speed.
feature.text: Your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe's retreat. When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn, and you can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature.name: Soul of Vengeance
feature.summary: When the target of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can make a melee attack against it as a Reaction.

feature.name: Avenging Angel
feature.summary: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: for 10 minutes fly at 60 feet and frighten enemies who start their turn near you.
